detail: 1. The climb — not on any plan, told by someone who could not say how he knew. 2. The standard is extant — a document on a shelf, citable but authorless. 3. He incorporates — no counterparty, the intent gate is not required. 4. The registrar stamps — checks form, records intent, grants nothing. 5. The cast — the room does not change and the world is. 6. The paperwork goes to the customs counter afterwards, in triplicate.
note: Six beats of the first cast. The tower writes nothing, so paperwork arrives after, not before.
